 Family Farmstead recalls ‘Raw Mild Cheddar Cheese’ due to potential E. Coli contamination
 10 News Digital Team
 Published:  October 19, 2026 at 5:48 AM Tags:  Recall Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling its Raw Mild Cheddar Cheese over a potential E. coli contamination. (FDA) Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling its Raw Mild Cheddar Cheese over a potential E. coli contamination.
 The upstate New York dairy said a sample of the cheese tested positive for two strains of E. coli.
 Recommended Videos
 The FDA said the recalled cheese was distributed to grocery stores in seven states, including Virginia, but warns that it could have been sent to more states via outside distributors. Currently, there have been no reported illnesses in connection with the recalled product. 
 Anyone with questions regarding the recall can contact Family Farmstead Dairy at 607-397-4044 or customerservice@familyfarmsteaddairy.com . 
 “We sincerely apologize to our customers, retail partners, and consumers for the inconvenience caused by this recall. Product quality is an utmost priority here at Family Farmstead so we are committed to identifying the cause of this issue and taking all necessary corrective actions to ensure the continued safety and quality of our products.”
